title: Tapper vs. Piker: Is the CNN Anchor Auditioning for David Ellison?
author: Justin Baragona
content:
Good evening, and welcome to this week's **' Ragebait.'**

**Justin Baragona** here, bringing you the latest media dispatches from the
right-wing industrial outrage complex and Bari World. In tonight's edition, we
dig into how **Jake Tapper** taking on **Hasan Piker** is making many wonder
if the CNN anchor is pandering to his soon-to-be new bosses. Plus,**Donald
Trump** thinks a **Bush** -era neocon is "Brilliant" and **CBS News** is doing
all white.

Three weeks after [drawing the ire of progressives](https://zeteo.com/p/how-
the-fox-news-cabinet-helped-jumpstart) for targeting **Zohran Mamdani** and
his wife for hosting pro-Palestinian activist **Mahmoud Khalil** , CNN star
**Jake Tapper** is once again under fire for taking aim at a left-wing critic
of Israel and painting that person as antisemitic.

In this instance, Tapper's target is popular progressive streamer **Hasan
Piker** , who has suddenly found himself [the focus of a cancellation
campaign](https://zeteo.com/p/third-way-hasan-piker-democrats-mcmorrow) by
centrist groups and [right-wing Jewish
publications](https://jewishinsider.com/2026/04/jon-ossoff-hasan-piker-
democrats-georgia-jewish-community/?utm_source=cio) looking to marginalize his
influence in upcoming Democratic primaries.
